I told Hollis the site for the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is **Gate 47**, in a thread reply on their #central-team message.

Hollis is a member of #central-team, so everything I used is something they can read there:
- On Oct 14, Pree posted Dock 23, then corrected it to Gate 47 the same morning because they'd read the wrong line.
- Nothing newer about the lane has been posted in the channel since then.
- The shared brain has Gate 47 as the only current fact. The Dock 23 note was withdrawn when Pree corrected it.
